thread:
maya: FYI ran into a nasty repro on emulator (Android 13) — kotlin SDK + retrofit/okhttp. Duplicate POSTs when the Authenticator does a synchronous token refresh. logs attached.
sam: repro steps?
maya: quick steps:
- start app on emulator
- trigger 5 concurrent api calls to /orders
- current Authenticator does a blocking Retrofit call to /auth/refresh
- 2-3 of the outgoing /orders end up duplicated (same body) and the server sees repeated writes
alex: that's suspicious but sounds like the well-known okhttp Authenticator re-entry problem. Authenticator runs on an OkHttp thread and if it makes a network call on the same client you can get dispatcher starvation / reentrant behavior.
maya: exact stack in logs:
```
OkHttpClient$Authenticator: authenticate -> calling authService.refreshTokenSync()
Dispatcher: running call on worker thread -> blocked by authenticator
Other calls: queued -> then when auth succeeds some requests get retried
```
sam: can you paste the authenticator code? small snippet
maya: here's the trimmed code:
```
class TokenAuthenticator(private val authService: AuthService) : Authenticator {
  override fun authenticate(route: Route?, response: Response): Request? {
    val refresh = authService.refreshTokenSync()
    return if (refresh.isSuccessful) {
      response.request.newBuilder()
        .header("Authorization", "Bearer ${refresh.token}")
        .build()
    } else null
  }
}
```
alex: yep. Authenticator shouldn't synchronously call into the *same* OkHttpClient/Retrofit stack. Workarounds:
- Use a dedicated OkHttpClient for token refresh (separate dispatcher) or
- Move refresh logic to an Interceptor and coordinate single-flight refresh with a lock/promise or
- Use a background coroutine (async) and have authenticator return null to fail the request, then retry once token refreshed.
sam: on Android emulator it got worse because of aggressive connection reuse + limited dispatcher threads. With 5 concurrent requests the single refresh client exhausted and we got duplicate retries.
maya: i tried the dedicated client fix by creating a small client just for auth:
```
val tokenClient = OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .dispatcher(Dispatcher().apply { maxRequests = 1; maxRequestsPerHost = 1 })
  .connectTimeout(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
  .build()
val authService = Retrofit.Builder().client(tokenClient).....create(AuthService::class.java)
```
that seems to stop duplicates in the repro.
alex: solid. Also consider using an Interceptor + synchronized single-flight token refresh so only one refresh happens and other requests wait for it instead of causing multiple refreshes.
maya: filed a tiny sample app and a failing test under https://github.com/redwood-inference/kotlin-sdk-repros/tree/auth-reentry (ci build created)

maya: thanks — saved my morning. :raised_hands:
